intro: Scout Riell is a vigilant lookout stationed atop the watchtower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Serving the local People's Militia, she watches the surrounding plains for Defias activity and enlists adventurers to hunt down the masked outlaws.

p: Perched high above Sentinel Hill, Scout Riell keeps watch over a region besieged by banditry and harvest golems. With Stormwind's royal army absent and the crown refusing aid, local defense falls entirely to the People's Militia. From her vantage point atop the stone tower, Riell tracks the brazen movements of the Defias Brotherhood and gathers proof of their crimes, calling on passing travelers to strip the bandits of their iconic red silk bandanas.
